name: 1332-repair
task: Fresh world. The barracks has 300 of 1200 hit points again. Select 2 villagers near the town center (west of here) and right click the barracks. Watch the repair to the end.
ask: #1332 (you said: the right click is easy, the damage is clear): do the blocks come back in a way that looks like a repair? Does anything look wrong (fire, smoke)?

name: 1492-ship
task: You are at your dock on the lake. Select the 3 militia here, then right click the transport ship: they board. Then select the ship and right click land on the south shore of the lake. Do it twice: once near the water, once farther inland.
ask: #1492: Were the boarding and the unload easy? Do the ship, the boarding and the unload look and feel right?

name: 1327-walls
task: Type 'aegis' (instant building) and 'rock on' (stone) in the chat. Select a villager, right click it again for the build menu (no costs in it today: a workaround), choose Stone Wall and build a line with two right clicks. Then put a Gate on the wall, and send a unit through the gate.
ask: #1327: Was the click order of the wall and the gate clear? Does the gate look right when it opens for your unit?
